SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.XCL_006 = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) 
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
WHERE m.XCL_010 = 'TR008'
